title: Don't build on the model's own output
statement: Don't build a model's examples or training data from its own output; draw them from real material outside it.
detail: An analysis memory for an AP question model's training names self-bootstrap as the corpus problem: its few-shot bank was earlier models' outputs plus their own. It records that the only lift on document-based questions that cost no other item type came from real documents, the only data from outside the chain, and that four dead-end versions shared the flaw.

evidence.quote: fewshot_bank = v43soup + v52b + their own outputs.
The ONLY non-zero-sum lift mechanism on DBQ historically was `d13` (LoC real documents) — the only data outside the chain.
